The governorship candidate of the Allied Peoples Movement in Oyo State, Bimbo Adekanmbi, has promised to sustain the development of Ladoke Akintola University of Technology, Ogbomoso, if elected governor. Adekanmbi gave the assurance on Monday during his campaign visit to the institution, where he addressed students and urged them to support candidates of the party in the forthcoming elections. In a statement issued by the Director of Communication and Spokesperson of the APM Campaign Council, Yinka Oladoyinbo, the candidate said his administration would implement policies and programmes to support students and make their aspirations achievable. He said the development recorded by the university under the administration of Governor Seyi Makinde would be sustained by an APM government. “All the demands that you have put forward will be looked into and implemented because the present administration and the one we plan to run believe in your ability to contribute to the development of the state. Also addressing the students, the party’s deputy governorship candidate, Muftau Salawu, who is from Ogbomoso, appealed to them to vote for Adekanmbi and other APM candidates. The party’s Oyo North senatorial candidate, Shina Abiola Peller, an alumnus of the university, said the forthcoming election offered students an opportunity to have one of their own represent them in the Senate. Peller urged the students to mobilise support for Adekanmbi, saying an APM administration would sustain the development recorded under Makinde’s Omituntun 1.0 and 2.0 programmes. He also called for collective efforts to address the country’s challenges and shape a better future for coming generations. Ademola Adegbite
